verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents that the Kafka table engine and materialized views work on its managed service. That lets the database itself continuously consume event streams without a separate ingestion pipeline. Continuous file ingestion is not shown: the s3() and url() table functions are one-shot pulls, and there is no evidence of a managed connector or auto-ingest-on-arrival feature. missing for 10: continuous file/object-storage ingestion as files arrive, managed ingestion connectors beyond Kafka, detailed docs on running Kafka consumption in the managed environment, independent or hands-on corroboration.
